M3 is built as a bounded discovery slice, not accepted as complete. Independent review and owner evidence remain required. All automated evidence here is from this cloud container; no phone results are inferred.

## Spread diagnosis and storage

All fourteen failed first-set scenes reproduce their original end digests, first discoveries and holder counts. Their 135 missing learners all end at skill 0; 32 have no observation credit and the remainder never reach five full credits. Of these learners, 133 accepted no lesson of any recipe; the other two accepted one each, not necessarily sharp-stone. Hourly probes found 70 never near active sharp work, and no sampled paused sharp lesson. Each scene still has 3–9 kind sharp-stone holders; missing learners have 32,216 comfortable-near-free-kind-holder hourly samples in total. Public history records only four taught sharp acquisitions across these fourteen scenes. This points to scarce completed observation/practice rather than absent kind teachers. Hourly sampling cannot distinguish every offer, refusal, material-fit shortage or interruption; no precise refusal count or causal calibration is claimed. Input availability and teaching opportunity calibration are proposed review questions; no T values were changed.

Day 45, seed 1001: 25,895 items, compressed snapshot 1,165,125 bytes. Of these, 22,541 have zero mass: 16,534 kernels, 2,894 crumbs, 2,501 chunks and smaller consumed carcass/core/bedding/food groups. Nearly all spent groups are referenced by history/parent links. Live flakes, crumbs, waste and ash carry actual conserved mass; they are not deleted. The carried-food index now avoids inert spent stock, while preserving retained heat-timer cursors and stable-ID order. Regression covers transfers, kinds, births/deletions, direct edits, shuffled handles and unchanged save bytes.

Spent inputs persist as full items for history links: ~22.5k spent items by day 45 (16.5k kernels). Scans must skip them; long games need compaction of spent items into history records (proposed for M4/M10 old-world storage).

## Checks and review

Touched closing strict-save/continuation regression: six assertions passed, 3.02 s /35.1 MiB; opaque History repair: seven app cases passed. Carried-food regression plus affected fire/save tests: 12 cases, 4,166 assertions, 3.58 s /40.7 MiB; lint/rules passed.

One integrated self-review (10:00–10:04 UTC) covered 360×800 portrait, large text, History and 800×360 rotation using software-rendered captures. The one bounded repair made History opaque. Cloud audio used Dummy: listening quality remains unmeasured.

Final routine **PASS**, 931.49 s /3.137 GiB peak: native simulation/view, ten one/four-worker digest suites, catalogue, formats/lints/source rules, 54 scripts/96 Godot cases, 165 tool cases, file/ID checks. Shared-header changes required 34 simulation and 13 view translation-unit lints plus 32 source-rule reads; unchanged passed files were retained. The initial routine took 290.56 s and found one unchecked-optional lint in the new test; explicit guard repaired it. No initial whole-routine PASS is claimed. The single milestone audit **PASS**, 3,314.28 s (55 min 14.28 s), 3.133 GiB peak: GCC/UBSAN and ARM/NDK native suites passed, TSan passed all 301 cases/1,768,842 assertions with no reported race, ten digest suites matched in all twelve runs including shuffled ties, 100 crash kills matched the unbroken result, and six planted oddities/repeat/recovery checks passed. Native flags/instruction scans, 96 Godot cases, 165 tool cases and file/ID checks passed. Build phase: 1,990 s; native/check phase: 1,314 s. The owner’s 12:08 instruction arrived after this audit had finished; no QEMU process remained to kill. The now-reduced audit policy keeps cross-compiler/M3 digests, TSan, shuffled ties and kill/scene/repeat only (owner, 10 October 2026); five new orchestration regressions passed in 5.853 s. Exact completed proofs seed its input fingerprints; no second full audit was run. No sustained rendered cloud or physical-phone measurement is claimed. Retained full-kit seed 1001 and idea pair 2001 also match their host end digests under GCC/UBSAN: 78.20 s /95.8 MiB and 20.75 s /77.8 MiB. These test cross-build equivalence, not frequency; ARM/NDK under QEMU also matches all four retained end digests: 240.83 s /94.7 MiB for learning, 52.37 s /70.4 MiB for the idea pair. This is emulation, not a physical-phone result.

The unconsumed-display-trail memory bug is fixed separately (`b7153b27`): synchronous seeks/recovery retain only their displayed endpoint. Regression verifies bounded knowledge copies and exact state. The then-current 297-case simulation suite measured 122.3 MiB; affected full Godot suite fell from a stopped 7.12 GiB case to 349.3 MiB. The native view's explicit historical-window stress retains 3.13 GiB; builds use two workers and long gates are memory-budgeted below ~7 GiB total.
